Together, we can accomplish great things and bring happiness to life through the power of play! Why Aristocrat? Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top-tier publisher of free-to-play mobile games. Aristocrat has three operating business units, spanning regulated land-based gaming (Aristocrat Gaming), social casino (Product Madness), and regulated online real-money gaming (Aristocrat Interactive). Our team of over 7,300 employees worldwide is united by our company's mission to bring joy to life through the power of play. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $110,500.00 - $152,000.00 Location: Santa Clara,CA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. Key Responsibilities Responsible for all technical support related aspects at a specific customer: escalations, fleet performance, system installations, improvement programs and upgrades. Acts as intermediary and field escalation focal point between customer and Division by providing technical support and documentation to field engineers, technicians and product support personnel who are diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing and debugging equipment. Provides Alpha Site support to Engineering specifically related to installation, operation, calibration, service and /or testing of a new hardware, process or software design in house or on an engineering tool Provides Beta Site Support; specifically related to installation, operation, calibration, service and/or testing of a new hardware, software or processes on a customer tool. Initiates and provides review of ECO's to ensure data supports fix and follow up with communication to the field. Generates and presents system performance data as required. This includes performance metrics such as MTBF, MTBI and Availability. Reporting will also include process data and I/W spending analysis. Supports GPS in the generation of documentation such as CENs and BKMs. Creates and reviews documentation covering technical improvements, system upgrades, and support plans. Presents at customer level. Ensures field implementation. Functional Knowledge Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines Business Expertise Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market Leadership Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements Problem Solving Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information Impact Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies Interpersonal Skills Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Yes, 50% of the Time Relocation Eligible: Yes The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable. For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement. Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. In addition, Applied endeavors to make our careers site accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us via e-mail at Accommodations_Program@amat.com, or by calling our HR Direct Help Line at 877-612-7547, option 1, and following the prompts to speak to an HR Advisor. This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

review_candidates.description: Company Description DE Marketing Creative Agency is a full-service digital marketing and creative firm that helps businesses increase visibility, engage audiences, and drive revenue through tailored, data-driven strategies. With over 10 years of experience in digital marketing, branding, and media production, the agency delivers measurable results for clients of all sizes. Services range from strategic digital marketing and branding to social media management and high-quality video, photography, and creative content. The team is client-focused, combining creativity with analytics to build unique brand identities and impactful campaigns. DE Marketing Creative Agency has partnered with recognized brands such as RoundKSA, Madinah Life, and Christian Dior, offering personalized solutions that support long-term growth. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Content Writer, Graphic Designer, Videographer, and Video Editor at DE Marketing Creative Agency. The role involves leading the creation of compelling written content for websites, social media, campaigns, and brand storytelling, while ensuring consistent tone and alignment with client strategies. The team member will design visually engaging graphics and marketing materials, including social media assets, brand collateral, and digital ads that support campaign goals. Daily responsibilities include planning, filming, and editing video content, creating motion graphics, and preparing media assets for various platforms and formats. The role also includes collaborating with marketing strategists, managing multiple creative projects, participating in client briefings, and optimizing content based on performance data and feedback. Qualifications Strong content creation skills, including senior-level writing, storytelling, and editing for digital channels. Graphic design expertise using industry-standard tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign or equivalents) for branding and marketing assets. Videography and video editing skills, including planning shoots, capturing footage, and editing using software such as Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar. Experience producing multimedia content for social media, websites, and digital campaigns, with an understanding of platform-specific formats. Ability to translate marketing strategies into creative concepts and content that supports business objectives. Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines in a remote environment. Comfort collaborating with cross-functional teams, receiving and integrating feedback, and presenting creative work to stakeholders. Relevant experience in digital marketing, branding, or creative agencies; a portfolio showcasing writing, design, and video work is required. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Design, Media Production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

review_candidates.company: Arab Women Investors Union (اتحاد المستثمرات العرب)
review_candidates.description: Company Description TCL (Technical Chemical Laboratories) is a long-established provider of effective and economical cleaning and hygiene solutions for hotels and hospitals across the Middle East, with more than 44 years of industry experience. The company offers a comprehensive range of sanitation and hygiene products for housekeeping, kitchen, laundry, personal care, floor care, swimming pools, and more. TCL operates factories in Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, and Russia, supporting a broad regional footprint and reliable supply. With over 10,000 team members working in TCL branches and with partners, the company focuses on delivering consistent product quality and competitive pricing. TCL values feedback and continuous improvement, reflecting a customer-focused and performance-driven culture. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive role based in Qesm El Maadi. The Sales Executive will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing customer accounts, and promoting TCL’s full product portfolio to hotels, hospitals, and other institutional clients. Daily activities include conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing and delivering product presentations, negotiating prices and contract terms, and following up on leads and inquiries. The role also involves coordinating closely with internal teams for order processing, delivery scheduling, and after-sales support, as well as tracking sales performance and preparing regular reports. The Sales Executive will maintain up-to-date knowledge of TCL products and market trends to offer solutions that align with client needs. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong sales and account management skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing techniques. Candidates should possess customer relationship and communication skills, with the ability to present technical product information clearly and professionally. Candidates should possess basic product and industry knowledge related to cleaning, hygiene, or chemical products, or demonstrate the ability to learn these quickly. Candidates should possess organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple accounts, visits, and reporting requirements effectively. Candidates should possess proficiency in using common office software and CRM tools to manage pipelines, documentation, and reporting. Relevant experience in B2B sales, preferably within hospitality, healthcare, or chemical products, is highly beneficial. A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Chemistry, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience in sales. Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Maadi, travel to client locations as needed, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Fluency in English and Arabic is an advantage, along with a results-oriented mindset and commitment to ethical, non-discriminatory practices.
